positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching assistant for Algorithms and Data Structures along with Introduction to Parallel Programming. I am responsible for assisting students during studio time, holding office hours outside of class, and grading assignments.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: I work in a team of four to develop tools for a study regarding the effects of a treatment on lung transplant patients. We are currently in the final steps of building a Quality of Life survey for Android to be used in hospitals nationwide. Experience within the project involves user interface, server-side development, and databases. The work also includes directly meeting with doctors and coordinators that lead the study to display progress, receive revisions or requests for features, and integrate workflow.
